'''Imperial Navy Intelligence''', also called '''Fleet Intelligence''' or '''Naval Intelligence''', was the military intelligence branch of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. [[Spurch Goa]] once worked as an investigator for it. Navy Intelligence also had interrogators, although they were implied to be less ruthless than their counterparts in [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].
